Your hair is feathered or neatly side-parted with volume. Behind you is a mottled blue and purple canvas crossed by faint pink laser lines, lit flat and evenly, with slightly cool colours, fine grain and a glossy print finish.
works: "Do not smooth my skin, whiten my teeth or change my face shape" guards against yearbook-style retouching. The backdrop line "blue and purple mottled canvas with faint pink laser lines" makes the result read as picture day in one glance. "Flat and even from a large soft source" plus "catchlight in each eye" sets the school photographer's lighting, and "no ... text, names or logos" stops the model adding a fake caption.
tips: Upload a front-facing head-and-shoulders photo with a neutral background; this is a close crop, so a sharp face matters more than anything else.
If the laser lines cover your face or look too neon, ask for "only faint laser lines behind the shoulder, away from the face" and regenerate.
For a plainer version, change the backdrop to smooth grey-blue mottled canvas, or swap the tie and blouse for a letterman sweater.
suits: Students, alumni planning reunions, friend groups doing a matching set, and anyone who wants a playful retro profile picture. It also works well for LinkedIn joke posts and class group chats.
personalize: Change the hairstyle, clothing colours and backdrop pattern to match what picture day looked like where you would have studied.
